<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/work.ts -->
<!--
  Milestones on a line: the year, a tag, a title and a sentence each. Axes: layout (split: a vertical line
  beside a picture, stacked: a vertical line in a narrow column, row: a horizontal line of columns), tone,
  density.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Milestone } from "./milestone-timeline.types";

  export type MilestoneTimelineProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    lead?: string;
    milestones: Milestone[];
    layout?: "split" | "stacked" | "row";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    density?: "default" | "compact";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Badge from "../primitives/badge/badge.svelte";
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import Inline from "../primitives/inline/inline.svelte";
  import List from "../primitives/list/list.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../primitives/list/list-item.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import Title from "../primitives/title/title.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    lead = "",
    milestones,
    layout = "split",
    tone = "default",
    density = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: MilestoneTimelineProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame
  id={id}
  title={title}
  lead={lead}
  tone={tone}
  density={density}
  layout={(((layout as string) === "split") ? "split" : "stack")}
  media={{ show: ((layout as string) === "split"), side: "start", align: "start" }}
  measure={(((layout as string) === "stacked") ? "2xl" : "default")}
  landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}
>
  <List
    tag="ol"
    class={
      (layout as string) === "row" ? "grid grid-cols-1 gap-8 border-t border-border sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4"
      : "flex flex-col gap-8 border-l border-border"
    }
    data-testid="items"
  >
    {#each milestones as m (m.id)}
      <ListItem
        class={
          (layout as string) === "row" ? "relative flex flex-col gap-2 pt-6"
          : "relative flex flex-col gap-2 pl-6"
        }
        data-testid="item"
      >
        <Inline
          class={
            (layout as string) === "row" ? "absolute top-0 left-0 size-2 -translate-y-1/2 rounded bg-primary"
            : "absolute top-2 left-0 size-2 -translate-x-1/2 rounded bg-primary"
          }
          aria-hidden="true"
        />
        <Group gap="2" align="center">
          <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
            {m.date}
          </Text>
          <Badge variant="outline" size="sm">
            {m.tag}
          </Badge>
        </Group>
        <Title as={3} size="lg" weight="bold">
          {m.title}
        </Title>
        <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {m.text}
        </Text>
      </ListItem>
    {/each}
  </List>
  {#snippet aside()}
    <MediaFrame alt={title} ratio="3/4" />
  {/snippet}
</SectionFrame>
